scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.prisma:postgresql: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); let s=fs.readFileSync('./prisma/schema.prisma','utf8'); s=s.replace(/provider = \"sqlite\"/, 'provider = \"postgresql\"'); fs.writeFileSync('./prisma/schema.prisma',s);" && npx prisma generate --schema=./prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.prisma:sqlite: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); let s=fs.readFileSync('./prisma/schema.prisma','utf8'); s=s.replace(/provider = \"postgresql\"/, 'provider = \"sqlite\"'); fs.writeFileSync('./prisma/schema.prisma',s);" && npx prisma generate --schema=./prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.render:api-build: npm run prisma:postgresql && npm run build:api
scripts.render:api-start: npx prisma db push --schema=./prisma/schema.prisma && npx tsx ./prisma/seed.ts && node apps/api/dist/index.js
